function pointGlowFor(THREE, def): Texture<unknown, TextureEventMap> | undefined

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/bodies/procedural/halo.ts:109

Generates the additive halo texture for a point star — a filled radial glow with a white-hot core and the body's tint in the tail. Galactic stars never resolve a photosphere at chart distances, so their whole luminous body is this sprite (no sphere mesh); the annulus would leave a hollow center with nothing inside it.
